MountCdsDisk.action: Action to perform on the disk, currently supported value: attach
MountCdsDisk.instanceId: ID of the virtual machine instance to attach the disk to
MountCdsDisk.deleteWithInstance: Whether the disk is deleted along with the instance, defaults to false; only supported for postpaid data disks
MountCdsDisk.deleteAutoSnapshot: Whether automatic snapshots are deleted along with the disk, defaults to false; supported for all disk types
